title: UNESCO assessment sets out 15 recommendations on AI readiness in Bangladesh
excerpt: Developed with the ICT Division, a2i and UNDP, the assessment reviews how prepared Bangladesh is to govern and use artificial intelligence responsibly.
content:
Research · Digital development · UNESCO, 14 October 2026

At a glance

  • Title: Bangladesh: Artificial Intelligence Readiness Assessment Report
  • Institution: UNESCO, with Bangladesh’s ICT Division, a2i and UNDP
  • Funding: European Union
  • Published: 14 October 2026
  • Method: UNESCO Readiness Assessment Methodology, using desk research and consultations with government, academia, civil society and the private sector

Summary

The report assesses Bangladesh’s preparedness to implement UNESCO’s Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence. It makes 15 recommendations, with priorities including stronger AI governance, closing digital divides, building skills and improving access to data and infrastructure.

Why it matters

Government services, health programmes and humanitarian agencies are starting to use AI tools. Development organisations working on digital inclusion, data protection and service delivery can use the assessment to understand where national policy is heading and where gaps remain.
